chrome-devtools.description: Chrome DevTools - page inspection, performance tracing, network monitoring

_comments.usage: Copy the servers you need to your ~/.claude.json mcpServers section
_comments.disabling: Use disabledMcpServers array in project config to disable per-project
_comments.context_warning: Keep under 10 MCPs enabled to preserve context window
_comments.languages: Optional list of language domains a server belongs to (e.g. ["node"]). A server without a languages field is treated as common and is installed for every language selection; one with a languages field is installed only when its list intersects the languages being installed.
